scope: BF16 image precision repair and FP32 preservation; external-corpus characterization
precision_boundaries: Load FP32 source weights; keep FP32 residual parameters, embeddings, LayerNorm, GroupNorm and detector decoder feed-forward layers.
Cast matrix and convolution inputs and weights to BF16 except FP32 decoder feed-forward layers and the segmentation head.
Evaluate the ViT first linear projection and tanh-GELU epilogue from BF16 operands in FP32; round once after GELU.
Accumulate BF16 attention, including additive bias, in FP32 and round the output once.
Round BF16 detection probabilities before confidence filtering; keep public scores FP32 and mask interpolation FP32.
Retain the segmentation head in FP32 to stabilize mask-logit zero crossings; this is a deliberate precision island, not CUDA operation-for-operation identity.

regressions.before: Original policy rounded LayerNorm parameters to BF16; assertion failed.
Returned two detections instead of one at confidence 0.5.
Both BF16 head variants failed FP32 logit equivalence.
Candidate fused paths replaced custom ReLU with GELU and failed on bias-free linear layers; both regressions were reproduced.

oracle_precision.bf16: Native official CUDA autocast; no fused-operation adapter.
oracle_precision.fp32: Established three-fused-casts-to-fp32 adapter; same reference as the passing FP32 baseline.

validation.tests: 901 passed; one expected warning from deliberate checkpoint-free model construction; final ViT owner recheck: 13 passed
validation.test_command: .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/image tests/runtime tests/port/tracker tests/test_temporal_runtime.py tests/test_temporal_parity.py -q
validation.qa: make qa: Ruff passed; strict Pyright reported zero errors and warnings
validation.graph: Refreshed with gitnexus analyze --index-only; CLI context and upstream impact used the current workspace index.

limits: The 56 cases were used to diagnose and calibrate precision; they are not an independent holdout or clinical qualification.
BF16 retains selected FP32 operations and requires FP32 source weights for those parameters.
FP32 remains the default. No BF16 temporal qualification or performance improvement is claimed.
